## Binary outcome models

- For all categorical DV models:
  - Functional form is inherently nonlinear, even without polynomials
  - All effects are interactive---meaning the effect of one variable can differ across various levels of other variables in the model, even without product terms
  - The size of the coefficient often does not clearly represent the size of the effect
    - Coefficients are not in the natural metric of the dependent variable
  - Predictions must be transformed into the natural metric of the dependent variable for more useful interpretations
    - Marginal effects can be calculated from predictions in the natural metric
